CLAUDE.md

Source: CLAUDE.md

This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.

Shared conventions

The portfolio’s shared rules (workflow, r-package, ci, native-code, correctness, assurance) come from the r-skills plugin’s rules/, loaded at session start because of the marker above. Never copy them here. Where this file and a shared rule disagree, this file wins for this package. Cloud sessions do not load the plugin and run without them.

What this is

zutable gives R typed tables: a data.frame that always knows the name, logical type (Arrow’s) and nullability of every column, queried through a bracket whose named arguments are SQL’s clauses (where, select, by, having, order, limit, distinct) over bare column names. The bracket is captured and translated into typed expressions over a closed vocabulary, so every result’s schema and every type error is known before data is touched; the same plan runs in the package’s own executor, over a file scan, or as SQL in DuckDB or zuspark. := updates existing columns in place through C. Beneath the local executor sits a grouped kernel (group, sort, join, reduce) with a C header for siblings. No Imports; LinkingTo: zufast from the first kernel code; every reader and engine is in Suggests. It deliberately does not invent an engine, add columns to an existing table, copy data.table’s surface beyond the bracket and :=, use threads, or exceed 2³¹ − 1 rows.

The specification is .agents/design.md (from RFC 0074) with the kernel in .agents/design-kernel.md (from RFC 0037). They outrank this file: CLAUDE.md orients, the design decides. Decisions marked (C) there are the RFC’s and may be overturned by the maintainer; (M) are the maintainer’s.

Current state

Scaffolded 2026-11-16 with create-pkg.sh (C via use_c()). Stage 0 (2026-11-17) gave it its identity, conditions and CI; no table functionality yet. The roadmap in .agents/roadmap.md takes it to v0.1.0; for now 0.1.0 includes the kernel (design D35).

Versions and dependents

The current version’s parent issue is #1 for v0.1.0. Sibling packages that depend on this one before CRAN does: none. Planned header consumers (zucsv, zuxlsx, zudedup, zulm) are listed in design-kernel §3. zutable cannot reach CRAN before zufast (on CRAN since 2026-11-16) and needs zuarrow’s release for its Arrow paths.

Commands

Only the shared commands so far.

Architecture

To be written as stages land; see .agents/design.md. The scaffold set up C through use_c(): src/zutable.c registers the routines and src/numbers.c wraps zufast’s number parsing and formatting (LinkingTo: zufast). The kernel’s header goes under inst/include/ and src/ stays a thin R translation over it (design-kernel §4).

Invariants that are easy to break

These are fixed by the design before any code exists:

  • No Imports. Every sibling and engine is Suggests; a type whose vector lives in an absent sibling is a zutable_type_error naming it, never a silent degrade to double or character.
  • No route changes a table’s schema. :=, $<-, [[<-, [<- keep the column set and types; names<- and assigning NULL are errors.
  • zt_commit() swaps column pointers and never writes into a vector, so a vector shared with another object is never corrupted and copy() duplicates only the list. It also enforces freeze() and clears column properties.
  • Every operator has a reference implementation in R over base, written first and kept as the oracle for the kernel (D29). Do not delete it when the C version lands.
  • The plan keeps the six lineage rules of design §8.5 from the first commit (resolved references, kept expressions, source identity, …), although lineage is not exported in 0.1.0.
  • The kernel header compiles as C11 without R under ZT_STANDALONE, and as C++17 (design-kernel §4, §8); nothing in src/ is an algorithm.
  • Errors are base-R conditions under zutable_error; no cli or rlang.

Testing

Conformance suite: none yet; DuckDB is planned as the oracle for the emitters and vocabulary (design §14). Helpers: none yet. Runtime: none yet.

Continuous integration

Calls the shared r-actions workflows r-cmd-check.yml (profile auto, plus in the full profile a Windows R-devel row, nosuggests and nold; weekly on Mondays 02:41 UTC), native-checks.yaml (sanitizers with ASan, valgrind, lto, rchk, analyzers, cran-special), gctorture.yaml (step 2000 on pull requests, step 20 daily and on dispatch), alloc-failure.yaml (weekly, through tools/alloc-exercise.R, which must reach every native routine), coverage.yml (badge on gh-pages) and assurance.yml (ungated-jobs: fail), plus r-lib’s pkgdown workflow. Dispatch gctorture at step 20 on the branch (gh workflow run gctorture.yaml --ref <branch>) before merging a change to PROTECTs. The kernel stages add check-headers, a consumer fixture and a fuzz target. Stages marked full in the roadmap: 3, 6, 10, 11, 12.

Tests run shuffled everywhere: tests/testthat.R and tools/ci-run-tests.R print their seed, and ZUTABLE_TEST_SEED replays an order.

Vendored native code

Planned by design-kernel §4.3: fluxsort and crumsort (Unlicense) as controls, swenson/sort (MIT) for harness rungs, and ports to C of Vergesort (MIT), ska sort (Boost 1.0) and pdqsort (zlib) with their licence notices kept. Pinned versions and local patches: to fill in when each is vendored.
